Curing method: demoulded 24 h, water curing until test
Conversions / notes: CS-0.37. Cement-only binder 1254 kg/m3, M-sand 456 kg/m3, water = w/c x 1254; PVA 26 kg/m3 (2 %). Only the min and max strength mixes of each sand grading are tabulated (6 mixes). VERIFY: curing age counted from casting; Table 3 duplicates 26.570 MPa (3 d) for FS-0.33 and MS-0.34; conclusions quote CS 3-d max 34.410 vs 36.410 in Table 3, so CS-0.37 3-d value omitted.
